I'm having the opposite problem. Everyone else looks and sounds fine to me, but some of them see and hear me stuttering, jittering and having these audio issues. Changing worlds fixes it for them sometimes, but then it starts affecting other people.
Hi all - checking in on this. Are we still experiencing this issue today?

@{58c62e995865713647a7115b|full_name}: Some people were still having problems the other night. Anything that induces high lag or strain on their systems seems to cause it. Restarting the game sometimes fixes it, but not always.
This has been fixed for the most part.
@{58c62e995865713647a7115b|full_name}: The loud popping noise seems to be prevalent in populated instances and I think I traced it to someone's avatar trying to play audio outside it's set range.

@{58c62e995865713647a7115b|full_name}: Seems no fix yet ...issue is even in low user number worlds , been having over 20 support mails ; love some technical updates on this issue , instead of the have you tried turning it off and back on again approach, has there been some tests ,

maybe rollback the system before these issues started to pop up (which apparently goes all the way to january)
@{58c62e995865713647a7115b|full_name}: I get it every now and again

@{5bbbf6aa17bab877dd8bc723|full_name}: I've had this problem too, and I've found it appearing most commonly in VRCDoom. I suspect it to be from worlds that hasn't been updated to newer patches but I can't be certain.

this is still a thing.
in fact it's worse.
you can end up in a situation where all voice audio ceases entirely. the only thing that remains is world audio and avatar audio- until you restart the game
